gen-fs-excon-gf-kadwa: Efficient and friendly, Excon packs its letters in tight like chalk marks on a full slate. And Kadwa, a classic serif, is where the pair is most distinctive: curves left open at the ends under a large x-height.
gen-fs-excon-gf-noticia-text: Dignified and literary, the body here has a big visible entrance into every curved letter. Noticia Text keeps its lowercase tall in the line, while Excon bends its s curves like wire that never thins at the spine.
gen-fs-excon-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla is a refined serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals. Excon draws hairline-free, shadow-free strokes, then hands over to paragraphs that read with authority, thanks to an e opened like a pried clasp.
gen-fs-excon-gf-pridi: Pridi stands its small letters up proud, almost capital-sized, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. And Excon holds every stroke to one steady line, which leaves Pridi to supply the refined, classic texture beneath.
gen-fs-excon-gf-scope-one: Scope One is a refined serif with stubby ascenders and descenders. Its counters spill out into the surrounding space, so paragraphs breathe, while Excon runs a single track width like a neon sign tube above.
gen-fs-excon-gf-slabo-13px: Excon draws its strokes with no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning. Slabo 13px, a bookish text serif, opens its rounded letters clearly, so nudging its size up a touch would pay off.
gen-fs-excon-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified, Suwannaphum lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter. Excon does best with bowls and stems drawn to match, while the text serif does best with a c as open as a bent paperclip.
gen-fs-gambarino-gf-science-gothic: Ink-heavy drama up top: Gambarino lays down fat stems with hairline whiskers, then hands off to Science Gothic. A sans whose letters read one at a time, without thick or thin.
gen-fs-gambarino-gf-syncopate: Gambarino stacks sturdy slabs of ink against razor-thin hairline serifs, all authority and drama. Syncopate, a sans-serif, runs on with technical-pen steadiness, its n arches matching the stems beside them.
gen-fs-hoover-archivo: Archivo brings an editorial, approachable voice, its curves opening outward instead of curling in. But Hoover does best at bookish confidence, its e throat wide like a funnel, while Archivo does best with a commanding x-height.
